project_name: Responsible Charity Society - AimGame Life-Changing Scholarships
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / EDITORIAL STATEMENT (With Vibrant Orange & Deep Green Accents)
design_tone: Confident, declarative, evidence-based, typography-led. Minimal photography with high intentionality. Awwwards Site-of-the-Day editorial aesthetic.
theme: Light mode default with dark slate contrast accents (Warm Off-white #FAF8F5 / Ivory background, Obsidian text #0F172A, Energetic Orange #E8490F / #F04E12, Deep Trust Green #166534 / #1E7A3C)

typography.heading_font: Outfit / Playfair Display / Syne or Clash Display fallback (Google Font: Outfit & Playfair Display)
typography.body_font: Inter or Plus Jakarta Sans (Clean, high-legibility sans-serif)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (For numbers, dates, age stats, 80G badges, manifesto indices)

scale.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
scale.section_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.eyebrow: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-emerald-800 font-semibold

visual_enhancers.hero: Kinetic Hero with line-by-line masked reveal animation, subtle floating grain texture, prominent brand badge, key metrics callouts
visual_enhancers.timeline: Signature 15-Year Timeline component (horizontal track on desktop with Lenis/drag, vertical stepper on mobile) covering ages 5->22 with 5 key expandable milestones
visual_enhancers.transformations: Respectful side-by-side childhood vs graduate/early career photo comparison cards, age 5 stats vs age 22 current salary/role stats
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon showing trust signals ('80G CERTIFIED SINCE 2012', '15-YEAR FULL-CYCLE SCHOLARSHIP', '100% COLLEGE GRADUATION', 'DIRECT FAMILY ERADICATION OF POVERTY')
visual_enhancers.manifesto: Numbered manifesto chapters with oversized indices (01, 02, 03) and high-contrast typography
visual_enhancers.donation_flow: 3-Step Gated Partnership Flow (Type Selection -> Threshold Check -> Direct Mocked Payment OR CSR/HNI Qualification Form routed to database & admin panel)
visual_enhancers.admin_view: Built-in /admin or modal route displaying routed contact & CSR inquiry submissions

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 6 key pages/sections are fully implemented with top-tier aesthetic polish: Home, The Program, Transformations, Partner/Donate, About/Trust, Contact.
Include built-in Admin Panel modal/view to examine saved CSR inquiries & routed contact submissions.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll triggers for buttery liquid motion.
Include high-contrast data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, forms).
Implement the signature 15-Year AimGame Timeline visually with interactive milestone expansion.
Use primary Orange (#E8490F) and Green (#166534) intentionally based on the official AimGame logo guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use pure black background or low-contrast text. Maintain APCA readability.
Never use raw generic Inter for headlines. Use Outfit / Playfair Display.
Ensure responsive padding (px-4 sm:px-8 lg:px-16) and never cram content.
Ensure headers have backdrop-blur and soft background opacity to prevent overlap artifacts.
